title: US Blames North Korea for Massive Binance Crypto Hack
excerpt: The FBI attributes a massive $6.3 billion cryptocurrency hack of Binance to North Korea, marking a historic digital theft.
body_html:
The Federal Bureau of Investigation has stated that North Korea is responsible for a recent massive cyberattack targeting Binance, the largest cryptocurrency platform.

According to federal authorities, the security breach resulted in the theft of $6.3 billion in digital assets. Officials noted this incident stands as the largest cryptocurrency hack in history.

The investigation into the multi-billion-dollar breach is ongoing, with federal law enforcement monitoring the movement of the stolen funds.
